AI Chat POC：首次對話與持續對話

长图

答

结论

BE 負責最終 context。 以下兩張圖直接展開 FE、BE 內部元件與 MockLLM 的完整呼叫鏈。

  1. 第一張圖：載入 history、建立 room、完成第一輪回答。
  2. 第二張圖：hydrate history、重建 canonical context、完成後續回答。1
  3. MockLLM 無狀態，每輪都由 BE 傳入完整 Responses API input。2

适用于POCtext onlyprocess-local memorystateless MockLLM

1

首次進入與第一輪對話

图的结构
  • FE · React fe
  • BE · Rooms Ctrl rooms
  • BE · Runs Ctrl runs
  • BE · Run Service service
  • BE · Memory memory
  • BE · LLM Provider provider
  • MockLLM · API mock
  • fe → rooms · GET /api/v1/chat-rooms?cursor=&limit=20
  • rooms → memory · listChatRooms(cursor, 20)
  • memory → rooms · ChatRoomPage（可為空）
  • rooms → fe · 200 { chatRooms, nextCursor }
  • fe → rooms · POST /api/v1/chat-rooms {}
  • rooms → memory · createChatRoom()
  • memory → rooms · ChatRoom { id, title: null }
  • rooms → fe · 201 Created + Location + ChatRoom
  • fe → runs · POST /api/v1/runs · JSON + Accept SSE
  • runs → service · executeRun(RunAgentInput, AbortSignal)
  • service → memory · getChatRoom(threadId)
  • memory → service · ChatRoom or not-found
  • service → memory · upsert user + create Run + assistant(in_progress)
  • memory → service · Run(in_progress) + assistant messageId
  • service → runs · yield RUN_STARTED { threadId, runId }
  • runs → fe · SSE data: RUN_STARTED
  • service → provider · streamResponse(LlmRequest, AbortSignal)
  • provider → mock · POST /v1/responses { input, stream: true }
  • mock → provider · 200 Content-Type: text/event-stream
  • mock → provider · response.created
  • provider → service · LlmStreamEvent.started(providerResponseId)
  • mock → provider · response.output_item.added
  • mock → provider · response.content_part.added
  • service → runs · yield TEXT_MESSAGE_START { messageId }
  • runs → fe · SSE data: TEXT_MESSAGE_START
  • mock → provider · response.output_text.delta（重複 N 次）
  • provider → service · LlmStreamEvent.textDelta(delta)
  • service → runs · yield TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT { delta }
  • runs → fe · SSE data: TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT
  • mock → provider · response.output_text.done
  • mock → provider · response.output_item.done
  • mock → provider · response.completed
  • provider → service · LlmStreamEvent.completed(usage)
  • service → memory · update assistant(completed) + Run(completed)
  • memory → service · updated records
  • service → runs · yield TEXT_MESSAGE_END
  • runs → fe · SSE data: TEXT_MESSAGE_END
  • service → runs · yield RUN_FINISHED { threadId, runId }
  • runs → fe · SSE data: RUN_FINISHED; close body
2

載入歷史與持續對話 context

图的结构
  • FE · React fe2
  • BE · Rooms Ctrl rooms2
  • BE · Runs Ctrl runs2
  • BE · Context Svc context
  • BE · Memory memory2
  • BE · LLM Provider provider2
  • MockLLM · API mock2
  • fe2 → rooms2 · GET /api/v1/chat-rooms/{id}/messages?cursor=&limit=50
  • rooms2 → memory2 · listMessages(roomId, cursor, 50)
  • memory2 → rooms2 · MessagePage ordered by createdAt ASC
  • rooms2 → fe2 · 200 { messages, nextCursor } → hydrate runtime
  • fe2 → runs2 · POST /api/v1/runs · full visible messages
  • runs2 → context · executeRun(input, AbortSignal)
  • context → memory2 · getChatRoom(threadId)
  • memory2 → context · ChatRoom
  • context → memory2 · upsert every incoming message by messageId
  • memory2 → context · reconciliation complete
  • context → memory2 · listMessages(roomId)
  • memory2 → context · canonical ordered history
  • context → provider2 · streamResponse(developer + eligible history + latest)
  • provider2 → mock2 · POST /v1/responses { input, stream: true }
  • mock2 → provider2 · 200 text/event-stream + response.created
  • provider2 → context · LlmStreamEvent.started
  • context → runs2 · yield RUN_STARTED + TEXT_MESSAGE_START
  • runs2 → fe2 · SSE: RUN_STARTED + TEXT_MESSAGE_START
  • mock2 → provider2 · response.output_text.delta（重複 N 次）
  • provider2 → context · LlmStreamEvent.textDelta(delta)
  • context → runs2 · yield TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT { delta }
  • runs2 → fe2 · SSE: TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT
  • mock2 → provider2 · response.output_text.done + response.completed
  • provider2 → context · LlmStreamEvent.completed(usage)
  • context → memory2 · store assistant + mark Run completed
  • memory2 → context · completed records
  • context → runs2 · yield TEXT_MESSAGE_END + RUN_FINISHED
  • runs2 → fe2 · SSE terminal events; close response
3

Context 與異常規則

階段BE 必須執行結果
Reconcile依 messageId upsert FE 傳來的完整 history重送 history 不會產生重複訊息
Filter只保留 completed user / assistant 文字訊息與最新 user turnfailed / incomplete assistant 不進模型 context
Instruct在 canonical history 前加入 server-owned developer instructionFE 無法覆寫系統規則
Pre-stream errorvalidation、room not found、auth failureHTTP 4xx + application/problem+json，不開 SSE
In-stream errorMockLLM error 或 response.failed更新 Run=failed，送 RUN_ERROR，不送 RUN_FINISHED
DisconnectFE 關閉連線AbortSignal 傳到 Provider / MockLLM，更新 Run=cancelled

来源

  1. AG-UI 1.0 Run Input
  2. OpenAI Conversation State
